Sam: Whirlpool reserved pool goes live 01:00 UTC. 3xA100, starting quota 120k tpm, expect short promo spikes to 170k. Need a short ops plan.
Lina: Propose quick canary: 10m shadow, 15m 30%, 25m 70%, then full for 90m. Recommend temp bump to 160k for 4h.
Marco: Runtime: autoscaler set to 65% util. For this, lower scale-out cooldown to 40s and keep scale-in 3m. Enable KV pre-warm for top-3 endpoints.
Jade: Customer require p99 < 180ms. They asked for hosted fallback if latency degrades.
Sam: Fallback rule: if p99 >240ms for 4m OR queue depth >140 for 3m -> shift 25% to hosted-fallback, alert #customer-success; manual approval to extend.
DeployBot: Loadtest scheduled: 01:05 UTC. Notifications -> #eng-runtime #customer-success.
Lina: k6 command ready: `k6 run --vus 180 --duration 20m scripts/whirlpool-promo.js`
Marco: Adding diagnostic header `x-rw-run: whirlpool-01` for traces.
Lina: Shadow run logs: "shadow 10m | rps ~3200 | p99 130ms | errs 0"
Sam: 30% stage: p99 145ms, GPU util 50%, KV hit 69%.
Marco: Noticed shard-4 queue rise; autoscaler added a GPU at 01:28 and rebalanced.
Jade: Customer: "Looks good. Proceed to full."
Lina: Full stage: sustained rps ~7200, avg p99 162ms, peak GPU util 79%. No errors.
Sam: Soak complete, no fallback triggered. Follow-ups: (1) file ticket to investigate shard-4 hot keying, (2) include cost snapshot in post-run notes, (3) consider bumping default burst cap for promo-heavy accounts.
Jade: I'll arrange renewal touchpoint in 10 days and the enablement session next Tue.
Marco: Post-run export -> /exports/whirlpool/3501234000.
Sam: Thanks team 2 thumbs-up."
